body: Fable2 GO wording (2026-10-31 13:37Z): the credited local form depends on the runtime. A Claude session runs `pushd "DIR" && <cmd>` in one Bash call, in background mode for a full gate. A Codex session runs the bare command as its own exec with cwd = DIR. In a Central GO, name the input, the census, the bare command and DIR, then add "in your runtime's credited form". Don't impose pushd/Bash on a Codex session. Sol-8e1f, a Codex session, correctly substituted the Codex form under GO #1708.
